scenes.title: Intro
en: Hello friends! If you want to apply for a new PAN Card online from home using your mobile or laptop, this video is going to be very helpful for you.
Today I will show you the complete step-by-step process to apply for a PAN Card on the official NSDL, that is Protean, website.
Which documents are required, how to fill the application form, how to pay online and how to track your PAN Card status — we will cover everything in this video.
Also, there have been some important changes to the PAN Card application rules in 2026 that you should know about.
So without wasting time, let's start the video.

scenes.title: Required Documents
en: First, let's talk about the required documents.
Before applying, keep your Identity Proof, Address Proof and Date of Birth Proof ready.
You can use your Aadhaar Card as Identity and Address Proof.
But here is an important update: from April 2026, Aadhaar Card is not accepted as Date of Birth Proof.
For Date of Birth, give a Birth Certificate, Passport or another eligible document. Do check the current list on the website.
Also keep your active mobile number, email ID, and if required, your photo and signature ready.
If your documents are ready beforehand, the application process becomes much easier.

scenes.title: Open Official Website
en: Now, first open the Chrome browser on your mobile or computer.
Then go to the official website of NSDL, that is Protean.
You will find the direct link to this website in the video description.
As soon as you open the website, you will see various PAN Card related services.
Remember, always apply only on the official website. Never enter your Aadhaar number or personal details on an unknown website.

scenes.title: Select Application Type
en: Now select the New PAN Card Application option.
If you are an Indian citizen applying for a PAN Card for the first time, select Form 93.
Earlier, Form 49A was used for this, but from April 2026 the new application form has come into effect.
Then select the correct Individual Applicant option and continue.
If you already have a PAN number, do not apply for a new PAN Card.

scenes.title: Online Registration
en: Now the registration form will open.
First, enter your name here.
Then fill in your date of birth, email ID and mobile number.
Take special care that your details match your documents.
If there is any difference in name or date of birth, there may be problems during processing.
Then complete the required consent and the captcha.
After registration, if you get a Token Number, save it.
With it, you can continue your application later if needed.

scenes.title: Submission Method
en: Now you need to select the method to submit your application.
Depending on your eligibility, you may see options like Digital Verification, e-Sign or Physical Document Submission.
If you want to complete the whole process online, select the available digital option.
But check the requirements of any option before selecting it.
If you have any issue with your documents or mobile number, choose the method that suits your situation.

scenes.title: Physical PAN or e-PAN
en: In the next step you may get the option of a Physical PAN Card or an e-PAN.
If you want the physical PAN Card delivered to your home address, select the physical card option.
And if you only need a digital PAN Card, select the available e-PAN option.
e-PAN is also a valid PAN document.
Choose the option that fits your requirement.

scenes.title: Personal Details
en: Now fill in your personal details.
Enter your full name, date of birth, gender and the required parents' details.
Where Aadhaar number and Name as per Aadhaar are asked, enter the correct details.
The spelling of your name must be exactly correct.
People often make small mistakes while filling the form in a hurry, which may need correction later.
So check all details carefully once before clicking Next.

scenes.title: Address & Contact
en: In the next section, fill in your contact and address details.
Enter required information like house number, area, city, district, state and PIN code.
If you selected a physical PAN Card, your delivery address must be exactly correct.
Keep your mobile number and email ID active, as application updates may come on them.
If a Source of Income option appears, select the correct option for your actual situation.

scenes.title: AO Code
en: Now let's talk about the AO Code.
AO Code means Assessing Officer Code.
If your application requires an AO Code, find the correct one using the search option on the website.
For this, check details according to your city, state and applicable tax jurisdiction.
Do not select a random AO Code here.
Verify the correct information before moving to the next step.

scenes.title: Document Upload
en: Now select your supporting documents.
Choose the correct documents for Identity, Address and Date of Birth Proof.
If your method requires uploading photo, signature or documents, upload them as per the file size and format given on the website.
Documents should be of good quality.
Uploading blurred or unclear documents can cause verification problems.
After uploading, check all details again.

scenes.title: Application Preview
en: Now we have reached the most important step of the application.
Before final submission, review your complete application.
Check your name, date of birth, address, mobile number and documents carefully.
If there is any mistake, correct it now.
Because making changes after final submission may not be so easy.
Move ahead only when all details are correct.

scenes.title: Online Payment
en: Now you need to pay the required PAN Card application fee.
The fee may differ based on your selected card type and submission method.
So always check the final amount shown on the official website before paying.
Then choose any available payment option as per your convenience.
After a successful payment, save your payment receipt.

scenes.title: OTP Verification & e-Sign
en: If you selected Aadhaar-based verification or e-Sign, complete the required verification now.
An OTP may come on your Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
Follow the instructions on the website to complete verification and e-Sign.
Never share your OTP with anyone.
If you chose physical document submission, submit your documents as per the instructions on the website.

scenes.title: Acknowledgement
en: When all required steps are completed successfully, you will receive an Acknowledgement Number or receipt.
Download this receipt and keep it safe.
With the Acknowledgement Number you can track your PAN application status later.
Also confirm that your application was submitted successfully.
A successful payment alone does not guarantee that the application is complete.

scenes.title: Track PAN Status
en: If you want to check whether your PAN Card is ready, you can track its status online.
For this, go to the official Protean website again.
Open the PAN Application Status Tracking option.
Then enter your Acknowledgement Number and other required details.
Now you will see the current status of your application.
PAN processing and delivery time depends on your application verification.

scenes.title: Important Warning
en: Before ending the video, remember one important thing.
If you already have a PAN number and lost your PAN Card, do not apply for a new PAN number.
Use the Reprint option instead.
And if the name or date of birth on your PAN Card is wrong, select the Correction option.
One person should not have more than one PAN number.

scenes.title: Outro
en: So friends, this is how you can apply for a new PAN Card online on the official NSDL, that is Protean, website.
I hope you understood the complete application process.
If the video was helpful, do like it and share it with your friends and family.
If you have any question about PAN Card, tell us in the comments below.
Subscribe to our channel for more useful and informative videos.
See you in the next video. Thank you for watching!
